item.html:
Rapid & Reliable Commercial Roof Repair

A leak in a commercial building is more than just a nuisance; it is an immediate threat to your inventory, your tenants, and your daily operations. Unlike residential roofs, commercial flat and low-slope roofs have highly complex drainage systems, numerous penetrations for heavy HVAC equipment, and miles of welded seams. When water finds a way in, it can travel laterally under the membrane, making the actual source of the leak incredibly difficult to find.

At Core Four Roofing, our commercial repair technicians are trained to identify and isolate these hidden vulnerabilities. We don't just patch the visible symptom; we conduct a thorough assessment of your membrane, flashing, parapet walls, and insulation. Whether you are dealing with ponding water, wind-lifted TPO seams, or puncture damage from recent rooftop foot traffic, we execute precise, permanent repairs that restore the watertight integrity of your building's envelope and delay the need for a costly full replacement.

item.html: Frequently Asked Questions About Commercial Roof Repairs
item.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Commercial Roof Repairs

items.q: What are the most common causes of commercial roof leaks in Texas?
items.a: The extreme Texas heat causes roofing materials to expand and contract, which eventually stresses the seams and flashing. The most common leak sources are failing membrane seams, degraded flashing around rooftop HVAC units or vents, ponding water, and puncture damage from severe hail or other trades working on the roof.

items.q: How do I know if I need a repair or a full roof replacement?
items.a: Our team provides an honest, photo-documented inspection. Generally, if the underlying insulation is dry and the membrane is still flexible, a targeted repair is highly effective. However, if core samples show that more than 25-30% of the roof's insulation is saturated with water, a full replacement is usually the most cost-effective long-term solution.

items.q: Can you repair my commercial roof while it is actively raining?
items.a: While we cannot perform permanent thermal welding or apply liquid sealants to a wet surface, we can absolutely dispatch an emergency crew to install temporary mitigation, such as commercial-grade tarping or water-diverting systems, to protect your interior until the roof dries enough for a permanent repair.

items.q: Will a repair void my existing commercial roof warranty?
items.a: Not if it is done correctly by a certified professional! Core Four Roofing is certified by major commercial manufacturers (like IKO and Malarkey). We use approved materials and techniques that ensure your existing No Dollar Limit (NDL) or manufacturer warranty remains fully intact.
